newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Airport charges draft delayed one week.
newsitem.headline: Airport charges draft delayed one week.

text.p: European Commission plans to adopt a draft directive setting a framework for airport charges have been delayed one week, spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said on Wednesday.
"The point was postponed, that will be dealt with next week," he told a news conference.

The proposal is intended to clarify the structure of charges imposed on airlines using Community airports, part of Commission efforts to maximise the benefits of its civil aviation liberalisation efforts, one official added.
"Within the context of liberalisation we have taken it on board to look at the impacts of airline charges and clearly, airport charges are among those," the official said.

"We are not seeking to harmonise charges but a Community framework so that they are all cost-related and transparent. We do not see it is necessary that airlines should be subsidising airports," the official addded.
